epics.title: Payment Gateway Integration
epics.description: Integration of a payment gateway to enable revenue generation, including credit card payments and subscription management

stories.title: As a customer, I want to make credit card payments, so that I can purchase products and services
stories.description: Enable customers to make secure credit card payments through the payment gateway
acceptance_criteria: The system successfully processes a credit card payment and updates the order status
The system handles declined credit card payments and displays an error message to the customer

tasks.title: Implement payment gateway API integration
tasks.description: Integrate the payment gateway API to process credit card payments

tasks.title: Develop payment form with credit card input fields
tasks.description: Create a secure payment form with input fields for credit card details

tasks.title: Handle payment processing errors and exceptions
tasks.description: Implement error handling for payment processing errors and exceptions

stories.title: As a customer, I want to manage my subscriptions, so that I can update or cancel my recurring payments
stories.description: Enable customers to view, update, and cancel their subscriptions
acceptance_criteria: The system displays a list of active subscriptions for the customer
The system successfully updates or cancels a subscription based on customer input

tasks.title: Design and implement subscription management UI
tasks.description: Create a user-friendly interface for customers to manage their subscriptions

tasks.title: Develop API integration for subscription updates
tasks.description: Integrate the payment gateway API to update or cancel subscriptions

tasks.title: Handle subscription-related webhook events
tasks.description: Implement event handling for subscription-related webhooks from the payment gateway

stories.title: As a system administrator, I want to receive payment notifications and generate receipts, so that I can track revenue and provide customer support
stories.description: Enable the system to send email notifications for successful payments and generate receipts
acceptance_criteria: The system sends an email notification to the customer and administrator for each successful payment
The system generates a receipt for each payment and makes it available for download

tasks.title: Implement email notification system for payment events
tasks.description: Develop an email notification system to send notifications for successful payments

tasks.title: Design and generate payment receipts
tasks.description: Create a receipt template and implement receipt generation for each payment

tasks.title: Integrate receipt generation with payment processing workflow
tasks.description: Integrate receipt generation with the payment processing workflow to ensure timely receipt generation

epics.title: User Authentication System
epics.description: A comprehensive system for user authentication, including login, signup, password reset, and OAuth integration

stories.title: As a user, I want to login to the system using email and password, so that I can access my account securely
stories.description: The system should allow users to login using their email and password, with validation and error handling for incorrect credentials
acceptance_criteria: The system validates email and password fields for empty or invalid input
The system redirects to the dashboard page upon successful login
The system displays an error message for incorrect email or password

tasks.title: Implement email and password validation
tasks.description: Write backend code to validate email and password fields

tasks.title: Create login form with email and password fields
tasks.description: Design and implement the login form with email and password fields

tasks.title: Integrate login functionality with backend API
tasks.description: Write code to integrate the login form with the backend API for authentication

stories.title: As a new user, I want to sign up for an account, so that I can use the system's features
stories.description: The system should allow new users to sign up for an account, with validation and error handling for duplicate emails or invalid input
acceptance_criteria: The system validates email, password, and username fields for empty or invalid input
The system sends a verification email to the user's email address upon successful signup
The system displays an error message for duplicate email or invalid input

tasks.title: Implement email, password, and username validation
tasks.description: Write backend code to validate email, password, and username fields

tasks.title: Create signup form with email, password, and username fields
tasks.description: Design and implement the signup form with email, password, and username fields

tasks.title: Integrate signup functionality with backend API and email service
tasks.description: Write code to integrate the signup form with the backend API and email service for verification

stories.title: As a user, I want to reset my password, so that I can recover my account in case I forget my password
stories.description: The system should allow users to reset their password, with validation and error handling for incorrect email or invalid input
acceptance_criteria: The system validates email field for empty or invalid input
The system sends a password reset email to the user's email address upon successful request
The system displays an error message for incorrect email or invalid input

tasks.title: Implement email validation for password reset
tasks.description: Write backend code to validate email field for password reset

tasks.title: Create password reset form with email field
tasks.description: Design and implement the password reset form with email field

tasks.title: Integrate password reset functionality with backend API and email service
tasks.description: Write code to integrate the password reset form with the backend API and email service for password reset

stories.title: As a user, I want to login using OAuth with Google and GitHub, so that I can access my account securely and conveniently
stories.description: The system should allow users to login using OAuth with Google and GitHub, with validation and error handling for incorrect credentials
acceptance_criteria: The system redirects to the Google and GitHub OAuth pages for authentication
The system retrieves and stores the user's profile information from Google and GitHub upon successful authentication
The system displays an error message for incorrect OAuth credentials

tasks.title: Implement Google OAuth integration
tasks.description: Write backend code to integrate Google OAuth for authentication

tasks.title: Implement GitHub OAuth integration
tasks.description: Write backend code to integrate GitHub OAuth for authentication

tasks.title: Integrate OAuth functionality with backend API and frontend
tasks.description: Write code to integrate the OAuth functionality with the backend API and frontend for seamless login

epics.title: Email Notification System
epics.description: A system for sending transactional emails to users, including welcome emails, password reset links, and payment receipts

stories.title: As a user, I want to receive a welcome email when I sign up, so that I feel engaged and informed about the platform
stories.description: The system should send a welcome email to new users with a personalized message and useful links to get started
acceptance_criteria: The welcome email is sent to the user's registered email address within 1 minute of signing up
The welcome email contains a personalized greeting and a link to the platform's tutorial
The welcome email is sent successfully even if the user has a non-standard email address

tasks.title: Implement email template for welcome email
tasks.description: Design and implement a template for the welcome email that can be personalized with user data

tasks.title: Integrate welcome email with user registration workflow
tasks.description: Modify the user registration workflow to trigger the welcome email send process

tasks.title: Test welcome email send process
tasks.description: Test the welcome email send process with different user scenarios and email addresses

stories.title: As a user, I want to receive a password reset link when I forget my password, so that I can regain access to my account
stories.description: The system should send a password reset link to the user's registered email address when they request a password reset
acceptance_criteria: The password reset link is sent to the user's registered email address within 1 minute of requesting a password reset
The password reset link is valid for at least 30 minutes and can be used to reset the user's password
The password reset link is sent successfully even if the user has a non-standard email address

tasks.title: Implement password reset link generation
tasks.description: Generate a unique password reset link that can be sent to the user's email address

tasks.title: Integrate password reset link with password reset workflow
tasks.description: Modify the password reset workflow to trigger the password reset link send process

tasks.title: Test password reset link send process
tasks.description: Test the password reset link send process with different user scenarios and email addresses

stories.title: As a user, I want to receive payment receipts when I make a payment, so that I have a record of my transactions
stories.description: The system should send a payment receipt to the user's registered email address when they make a payment
acceptance_criteria: The payment receipt is sent to the user's registered email address within 1 minute of making a payment
The payment receipt contains the payment amount, date, and a unique transaction ID
The payment receipt is sent successfully even if the user has a non-standard email address

tasks.title: Implement payment receipt generation
tasks.description: Generate a payment receipt that can be sent to the user's email address

tasks.title: Integrate payment receipt with payment processing workflow
tasks.description: Modify the payment processing workflow to trigger the payment receipt send process

tasks.title: Test payment receipt send process
tasks.description: Test the payment receipt send process with different payment scenarios and email addresses

stories.title: As a developer, I want to integrate the email notification system with SendGrid or AWS SES, so that I can send emails reliably and efficiently
stories.description: The system should integrate with a reliable email service provider to send emails
acceptance_criteria: The system can send emails successfully using SendGrid or AWS SES
The system can handle email bounces and complaints
The system can track email opens and clicks

tasks.title: Set up SendGrid or AWS SES account
tasks.description: Create and configure a SendGrid or AWS SES account for email sending

tasks.title: Integrate email notification system with SendGrid or AWS SES API
tasks.description: Modify the email notification system to use the SendGrid or AWS SES API for email sending

tasks.title: Test email sending with SendGrid or AWS SES
tasks.description: Test the email sending process with SendGrid or AWS SES to ensure reliability and efficiency

epics.title: Admin Dashboard
epics.description: A dashboard for internal team to manage users and monitor the platform, including user management, analytics, and system health monitoring

stories.title: As an admin, I want to manage users, so that I can control access to the platform
stories.description: The admin dashboard should allow administrators to create, update, and delete user accounts
acceptance_criteria: The admin can create a new user account with a unique username and password
The admin can update an existing user's role and permissions
The admin can delete a user account and remove their access to the platform
The system prevents duplicate usernames and validates password strength

tasks.title: Design and implement user management UI
tasks.description: Create a user-friendly interface for managing user accounts

tasks.title: Develop user account creation and update functionality
tasks.description: Write backend code to handle user account creation and updates

tasks.title: Implement user account deletion and access removal
tasks.description: Write backend code to handle user account deletion and remove access to the platform

stories.title: As an admin, I want to view analytics dashboards, so that I can monitor platform performance
stories.description: The admin dashboard should display key metrics and analytics to help administrators understand platform performance
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard displays real-time metrics on active users and revenue
The dashboard displays system performance metrics, including error rates and response times
The dashboard allows administrators to filter and drill down into specific metrics
The system updates metrics in real-time and handles large volumes of data

tasks.title: Design and implement analytics dashboard UI
tasks.description: Create a user-friendly interface for displaying key metrics and analytics

tasks.title: Develop backend API to retrieve and process metrics data
tasks.description: Write backend code to handle data retrieval and processing for metrics and analytics

tasks.title: Implement data visualization and filtering functionality
tasks.description: Write frontend code to handle data visualization and filtering for the analytics dashboard

stories.title: As an admin, I want to monitor system health, so that I can identify and resolve issues
stories.description: The admin dashboard should display system health metrics and alerts to help administrators identify and resolve issues
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard displays system health metrics, including CPU usage and memory usage
The dashboard displays error logs and alerts for system issues
The system sends notifications to administrators for critical system issues
The dashboard allows administrators to view and manage system logs

tasks.title: Design and implement system health monitoring UI
tasks.description: Create a user-friendly interface for displaying system health metrics and alerts

tasks.title: Develop backend API to retrieve and process system health data
tasks.description: Write backend code to handle data retrieval and processing for system health metrics

tasks.title: Implement notification and alert functionality
tasks.description: Write backend code to handle notification and alert functionality for system issues

stories.title: As an admin, I want to manage configuration, so that I can customize the platform
stories.description: The admin dashboard should allow administrators to manage configuration settings for the platform
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard allows administrators to view and edit configuration settings
The system validates and saves configuration changes
The system applies configuration changes to the platform
The dashboard displays a history of configuration changes

tasks.title: Design and implement configuration management UI
tasks.description: Create a user-friendly interface for managing configuration settings

tasks.title: Develop backend API to retrieve and update configuration data
tasks.description: Write backend code to handle data retrieval and updates for configuration settings

tasks.title: Implement configuration change history and auditing
tasks.description: Write backend code to handle configuration change history and auditing

stories.title: As an admin, I want to view real-time metrics, so that I can monitor platform activity
stories.description: The admin dashboard should display real-time metrics on platform activity, including active users and revenue
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard displays real-time metrics on active users
The dashboard displays real-time metrics on revenue
The system updates metrics in real-time and handles large volumes of data
The dashboard allows administrators to filter and drill down into specific metrics

tasks.title: Design and implement real-time metrics UI
tasks.description: Create a user-friendly interface for displaying real-time metrics

tasks.title: Develop backend API to retrieve and process real-time metrics data
